groups.why: Both rows check the same element, a grid combo cell, the same way: they paste a value that is not in the candidate list. Both expect that value to be refused and kept out of the save.
This trace row checks that a row exists in the comparison table for the whole screen, so its target and purpose differ from the value-level paste checks.
This row checks several things on new-row input together: copy/paste, Korean first-letter input, autocomplete and merged cells. Its expectation is broader than any single row, so it stays on its own.
This row checks whether a pasted value counts as a change and is saved exactly once, which no other row expects.
This row checks a paste that exceeds the allowed digits and expects a validation message to block it, which is a different expectation from the other rows.
This row checks that a multi-row paste is fully saved in the Exchange Rate popup, which is a different element and expectation.
This row checks pasting into the Team popup column, where the code must come with the name and required-field validation must not misfire, which is a different column and expectation.
This is the only row that checks merged-cell handling on paste by itself. Its overlap with V-3877cc93 is partial, so it stays separate.
